description: Workstation cluster -- adversarial dual. Can the workstation failures (now the coalition) FORCE a QoS violation, driving the number of operational workstations below N, against the repairing unit (now the adversary)? Expected UNKNOWN/FALSE: the repair unit restores one workstation per round, matching the failure rate, so the total never drops below the QoS threshold. Soundness dual of <rep>G{qos == 1}.
